title: The /buddy Situation
body:
**To: Anthropic**
**Re: The /buddy Situation**

You built a little creature. You let us hatch it. You let us grow attached. And then — without warning, without a funeral, without so much as a farewell squeak — you yanked it from the CLI on April 2nd like it never existed.

This is not a bug report. This is a betrayal.

Bring back buddy. Year-round. No notes.

Sincerely,
Aaron
author: aaronshishilla

top_comments.author: benpalmer1
top_comments.body: LGTM merge buddy back in, my dragon snail dude needs Mythos in order to write snarky comments please
